steps: Use the serviceable autopilot

procedures: (O) Manual thrust for the whole flight
(O) Approach limited to CAT 1: no low-visibility approaches
name: Autothrust
plain: The autothrust is inoperative
steps: Fly with manual thrust throughout

description: APU generator inoperative (APU bleed still available)

procedures: (M) Not dispatchable until inspected

procedures: (O) Inform the cabin crew: reduced hot service on this galley

steps: Brief the cabin crew: limited hot service

procedures: (M) Pump depressurised and secured

Expect slower operation of the services on that hydraulic system

steps: Switch off the PTU and keep it off for the whole flight
No pressure transfer between the green and yellow systems

procedures: (O) Not to be operated into known or forecast thunderstorm areas
name: Weather radar

steps: Do not plan the flight through forecast thunderstorm activity. Amend your route and planning accordingly

steps: Make sure the transponder works
Tell air traffic control

steps: Select the serviceable transponder

dispatch_consequence: Ground power and air start needed at every stand
procedures: (O) Ground power and conditioned air on stand
(O) Engine start with an air start unit, or crossbleed start after the first engine
(O) No APU backup for electrics or bleed in flight
name: APU
plain: The APU is inoperative
steps: Ground operations: external electrical power and pneumatic air are needed for aircraft preparation and engine start
Engine start: start the first engine with ground air; use ground air or a cross-bleed start for the second
Cabin systems: before and after flight, air conditioning depends on external air or engine bleed air
In-flight effect: with both engines and generators operating, the aircraft is normally unaffected in routine flight
Main limitation: electrical and pneumatic backup is lost, so a subsequent engine, generator or bleed-air failure has greater operational impact

procedures: (M) Bleed valve secured closed

(O) Crossbleed open for wing anti-ice from the other side

(O) Not to be operated in known or forecast icing conditions
